turns.question: What was the total ad spend in EUR per non-cancelled order placed in September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for ad spend per non-cancelled order, so I cannot give that figure. The closest metrics are Ad spend (EUR), Revenue (EUR), Average order value (EUR) and Orders (Cancelled orders are counted in Orders, so a per-non-cancelled-order figure would need a metric the layer does not hold).
